biggest_catch: Both sides only get the $100 after the friend opens a Rewards Checking account with a $50 minimum deposit - and the friend's account carries a $100 early-closure fee if closed within 6 months.
catches: Friend must become a CommonWealth member and open a Rewards Checking Account; online joiners use promo code SHARE100 and must mention the referrer.
A minimum $50 deposit is required in the checking account to receive the gift.
$100 fee for closing the account within 6 months.
New members and new checking only; members with an existing CommonWealth checking account are ineligible; one new checking account per new member.
IRS reporting: referred member gifts over $10 on 1099-INT; referrer gifts over $2,000 on 1099-MISC.
Offer subject to cancellation without notice; cannot be combined with other offers; ChexSystems verification on new accounts.

steps: Tell friends about CommonWealth membership and the $100 referral offer.
Friend joins CommonWealth and opens a Rewards Checking Account (online with promo code SHARE100, in branch, or by video chat), mentioning you as the referrer and depositing at least $50.
